about.title: Driving global excellence through innovation
about.subtitle: We’re a full-cycle IT company that builds websites, apps, cloud platforms — and our own products like DockPass.
story: AMS IT Services began with a simple idea: small and mid-sized businesses deserve the same quality of technology as global enterprises.

Today our team of 50+ specialists works from Memphis, Tennessee and Hyderabad, India, delivering custom web development, mobile apps, e-commerce, cloud and marketing services to clients around the world.
We also build and operate our own software products. Our flagship, DockPass, helps warehouses verify every driver and stop cargo theft at the dock.

dockpassPage.problemTitle: Paperwork doesn’t show who is actually driving the truck.
dockpassPage.howTitle: Four steps from shipment to sign-off
dockpassPage.featuresTitle: Everything you need to secure the dock
dockpassPage.gateText: Guards scan the pass with a phone camera or type the code. DockPass confirms the driver, shipment and gate match — the pass must be valid, unused and unexpired, or it’s denied. Every scan is logged with guard, gate and time.
dockpassPage.industriesTitle: Built for warehouses moving high-value freight
dockpassPage.ctaTitle: Every truck traced to a real shipment, a verified driver and a single-use pass.
